## load packages:

## Read data 

Reads file compiled in `01_prepare_data.Rmd`:
```{r}
d0 <- get_derived_data()
```


## Make baseline dataset

### Extract baseline data

Extract data from screening visit:
```{r}
db1 <- d0[!is.na(rand_id) & c_visit %in% c("screen")]
# db1[, .N, rep_inst]
# db1[, .N, variable]

## Check that screening dates are unique:
db1[, no_dates_per_id := uniqueN(date), ID]
# db1[, .N, no_dates_per_id]
stopifnot(db1[, all(no_dates_per_id == 1)])

## convert to wide format:
convert2wide <- function(data) {
  .d <- copy(data)
  .d[, variable2 := fifelse(variable == part, variable, paste0(variable, "_", part))]
  
  dn <- if(.d[!is.na(value), .N] == 0) data.table(NULL) else 
    dcast(.d[!is.na(value)], ID + trt ~ variable2, value.var = "value")
  dc <- if(.d[!is.na(c_value), .N] == 0) data.table(NULL) else 
    dcast(.d[!is.na(c_value)], ID + trt ~ variable2, value.var = "c_value")
  dd <- if(.d[!is.na(d_value), .N] == 0) data.table(NULL) else 
    dcast(.d[!is.na(d_value)], ID + trt ~ variable2, value.var = "d_value")
  
  ll <- list(dn, dc, dd)
  ll <- ll[sapply(ll, nrow) > 0]
  if(length(ll) == 0) return(data.table(NULL))
  if(length(ll) == 1) return(ll[[1]])
  if(length(ll) >= 2) {
    res <- ll[[1]]
    for(i in 2:length(ll)) {
      res <- merge(res, ll[[i]], by=c("ID", "trt"), all=TRUE, sort=FALSE)
    }
    return(res)
  }
}

dscreen <- convert2wide(db1)
dscreen <- merge(unique(db1[, .(ID, screen_dato = date)]),
                 dscreen, by="ID", all.y=TRUE)

dscreen[, -"screen_komm"]
```

Extract data from day0 visits:
```{r}
db2 <- d0[c_visit == "day0" & !is.na(rand_id)]
setorder(db2, ID, variable, part, -rep_inst)
db2 <- db2[, .SD[1], .(ID, variable, part)]

varib <- c("sex", "koen_identitet", "etnicitet", "dep_start", "dep_diagnose_journal",
           "uddannelse", "arbmark_outcome", 
           "etnicitet", "rygning", "dep_diagnose_scan", "dep_diagnose_scan_melank",
           "dep_tidligere",
           "dep_tidligere_antal", "antal_antidep", "antidep_tidligere_antal",
           "antidep_tidligere_janej",
           "psyk_aktuelt_janej", "psyk_aktuelt", "psykter_janej", "psykter_tidligere_janej",
           "ambulant_indlagt",
           "alkohol_janej", "alkohol_genstande", "alkohol_skadelig", "alkoholafhaengighed", 
           "rygning", "pakkeaar", "stoffer_aktuelt", "stoffer_aktuelt_spec", 
           "stoffer_skadeligt", "stoffer_tidligere", "stoffer_tidligere_spec", 
           "indkomst",
           "sysblodtryk", "diablodtryk", "puls", "temp", "respirationsfrekvens", 
           "hoejde", "vaegt", "mens_janej", "mens_start", "andre_sygdomme_janej",
           "qtc_interval", "crp",
           getgrep("^antidep_\\d*_start$", db2[, unique(variable)]),
           getgrep("^antidep_tidligere_\\d*_start$", db2[, unique(variable)])
)
stopifnot(db2[, all(varib %in% variable)])

db2a <- db2[variable %in% varib | 
              (variable %in% d0[, unique(variable)] & 
                 part %in% c("total", "total10", "total6", "total17"))]

dday0 <- convert2wide(db2a)
dday0 <- merge(dday0, unique(db2[, .(ID, d_day0)]), by="ID", all=TRUE)
dim(dday0)
```

Merge baseline data from screening and day0 visits:
```{r}
dbl <- merge(dscreen, dday0, by=c("ID", "trt"), all=TRUE)
dim(dbl)
```

### Derive additional baseline variables

```{r, results='hide'}
## SEX
dbl[, c_sex := fifelse(sex == "Kvinde", "Female", "Male")]


## AGE
dbl[, n_age := (d_day0 - foedselsdag)/365.25] # age at day0


## BMI
dbl[, n_bmi := vaegt / (hoejde/100)^2]


## CRP
dbl[, n_crp := crp]
dbl[substr(crp, 1, 1) == "<", n_crp := NA]
dbl[, n_crp := comma2numeric(n_crp)]
dbl[, f_crp2 := factor(fifelse(is.na(n_crp) | n_crp < 2, "<2", ">=2"),
                       levels = c("<2", ">=2"))]
dbl[is.na(crp), f_crp2 := NA] # Need to restore NAs from orig 'crp' var
# dbl[, .N, keyby = f_crp2] |> totpct()

# If f_crp2 has any NAs, we impute using median of the censored variable.
# This variable is needed for subgroup analyses:
if(dbl[, any(is.na(f_crp2))]) {
  dbl[, lwr_crp := 1.0 * grepl("<", crp)]
  dbl[, lim_crp := fifelse(lwr_crp == 1, comma2numeric(gsub("<", "", crp)), n_crp)]
  Y <- dbl[!is.na(lim_crp), Surv(time=lim_crp, event=(lwr_crp == 0), type="left")]
  med_crp <- get_cens_median(Y, digits = 5)[1, median]
  # If the median it self is censored, we impute by the LLOQ:
  med_crp <- gsub("<", "", med_crp) |> as.numeric()
  dbl[, n_crp3 := fifelse(is.na(crp), med_crp, n_crp)]
  dbl[, f_crp3 := factor(fifelse(is.na(n_crp3) | n_crp3 < 2, "<2", ">=2"),
                         levels = c("<2", ">=2"))]
  # dbl[, .N, .(f_crp2, f_crp3)]
} else {
  dbl[, f_crp3 := f_crp2]
}
stopifnot(dbl[, sum(is.na(f_crp3)) == 0])

## RACE/ETHNICITY
dbl[, f_race := factor(fifelse(etnicitet == "Kaukasisk", "White", "Other"),
                        levels = c("White", "Other"))]

## SOMATIC COMORBIDITY
dbl[, f_somatic_comorbid := factor(fifelse(andre_sygdomme_janej == "Ja", "Yes", "No"),
                                   levels = c("Yes", "No"))]

## SMOKING
dbl[, f_smoking := factor(rygning)]
levels(dbl$f_smoking) <- list("Current" = c("Festryger", "Nuværende ryger"),
                               "Former" = "Tidligere ryger",
                               "Never" = "Ikke-ryger")


## EMPLOYMENT
dbl[, f_employment := factor(arbmark_outcome)]
levels(dbl$f_employment) <- list("Employed" = c("Fuldtidsjob", "Deltidsjob", 
                                                 "Flexjob eller anden jobordning på nedsat tid"),
                                  "Student" = "Studerende (fuldtid)", 
                                  "Sick leave" = c("Sygemeldt (fra job eller studie)",
                                                   "Førtidspension"),
                                  "Unemployed" = "Ledig",
                                  "Other" = "Andet")

## CURRENT USE OF PSYCHOTHERAPY
dbl[, f_cur_psychotherapy := factor(fifelse(psykter_janej == "Ja", "Yes", "No"),
                                    levels = c("Yes", "No"))]
dbl[, .N, keyby = .(f_cur_psychotherapy, psykter_janej)]

## PREVIOUS USE OF PSYCHOTHERAPY
dbl[, f_prev_psychotherapy := factor(fifelse(psykter_tidligere_janej == "Ja", 
                                             "Yes", "No"),
                                     levels = c("Yes", "No"))]
dbl[, .N, keyby = .(f_prev_psychotherapy, psykter_tidligere_janej)]

## RECURRENT DEPRESSIVE EPISODES
dbl[!is.na(dep_diagnose_scan), f_dep_recurrent := 
      factor(fifelse(grepl("periodevis", dep_diagnose_scan), "Yes", "No"),
             levels = c("Yes", "No"))]
dbl[, .N, .(f_dep_recurrent, dep_diagnose_scan)]

## DURATION OF CURRENT DEPRESSIVE EPISODE
dbl[, n_dep_current_duration_days := as.numeric(d_day0 - dep_start)]
dbl[, f_dep_current_duration := cut(n_dep_current_duration_days, 
                                    breaks=c(-Inf, 0, 365/2, 365, 2*365, Inf),
                                    labels=c("<0 yrs", "0 - 1/2 yrs", "1/2 - 1 yrs", "1 - 2 yrs", ">2 yrs"))]
dbl[, .N, keyby=f_dep_current_duration]

## LIFETIME DEPRESSIVE EPISODES
dbl[, .N, dep_tidligere]
dbl[!is.na(dep_tidligere),
    n_dep_lifetime_episodes := fifelse(dep_tidligere == "Ja", dep_tidligere_antal + 1, 1)]
dbl[, .N, n_dep_lifetime_episodes]

## DIFFERENT CURRENT OR PREVIOUS PHARMACOLOGICAL TREATMENTS FOR DEPRESSION
# Based on information in the following 3 variables:
dbl[, .N, .(antidep_tidligere_janej, antal_antidep, antidep_tidligere_antal)]

dbl[!is.na(antidep_tidligere_janej), antal_antidep_all := 
      fifelse(antidep_tidligere_janej == "Ja", antal_antidep + antidep_tidligere_antal, antal_antidep)]
dbl[, .N, antal_antidep_all]

dbl[, .N, keyby=.(antal_antidep, antidep_tidligere_antal)]
dbl[, f_antal_antidep_all := cut(antal_antidep_all, breaks = c(.5, 1.5, 2.5, Inf),
                                 labels=c("1", "2", "3+"))]
dbl[, .N, keyby=.(f_antal_antidep_all)]
dbl[, .N, keyby=.(f_antal_antidep_all, antal_antidep_all)]


## COMORBID PSYCHIATRIC DISORDERS
dbl[, .N, .(psyk_aktuelt_janej, psyk_aktuelt)]
dbl[!is.na(psyk_aktuelt_janej) & psyk_aktuelt_janej == "Nej", n_psyk_aktuelt := 0]
dbl[!is.na(psyk_aktuelt_janej) & psyk_aktuelt_janej == "Ja" & !is.na(psyk_aktuelt), 
    n_psyk_aktuelt := sapply(strsplit(psyk_aktuelt, ","), length)]
dbl[, .N, .(psyk_aktuelt_janej, psyk_aktuelt, n_psyk_aktuelt)]
dbl[, f_psyk_aktuelt := cut(n_psyk_aktuelt, breaks=c(-.1, .5, 1.5, Inf),
                            labels=c("0", "1", "2+"))]
dbl[, .N, .(psyk_aktuelt_janej, psyk_aktuelt, n_psyk_aktuelt, f_psyk_aktuelt)]
dbl[, .N, keyby=f_psyk_aktuelt]


## CURRENT TREATMENT SETTING
dbl[, .N, ambulant_indlagt]
dbl[, f_ambulant_indlagt := factor(ambulant_indlagt)]
levels(dbl$f_ambulant_indlagt) <- 
  list("Hospitalized (in-patient)" = c("Indlagt"),
       "Psychiatric out-patient clinic" = 
         "Ambulant (sekundær sektor - eks. henvist til pakkeforløb, fulgt i akutteam)",
       "General Practitioner (GP)" = c("Privatpraktiserende psykiater", "Egen læge"))
dbl[, .N, keyby=.(f_ambulant_indlagt, ambulant_indlagt)]
```

Baseline variables for subgroup analyses:
```{r, results='hide'}
## AGE <40 VS. >=40
dbl[, .(ID, n_age)]
dbl[, f_age40 := factor(fifelse(n_age < 40, "<40", ">=40"))]
dbl[, .N, keyby=f_age40]

## BMI <30 VS. >= 30
dbl[, .(ID, n_bmi)]
dbl[, f_bmi30 := factor(fifelse(n_bmi < 30, "<30", ">=30"))]
dbl[, .N, keyby=f_bmi30]

## DEPRESSION SEVERITY: MADRS <= 29 VS. >=30
dbl[, .(ID, madrs_total10)]
dbl[, f_madrs10_30 := factor(fifelse(madrs_total10 < 29.5, 
                                     "Moderate", "Severe"))]
dbl[, .N, keyby=f_madrs10_30]

## TREATMENT-RESISTANT 
## no. started antidepressants <2 (no) >= 2 (yes)

# Compute number of antidepressants started between dep_start and d_day0 (both
# included):
antidep_start_var <- 
  c(getgrep("^antidep_\\d*_start$", db2[, unique(variable)]),
    getgrep("^antidep_tidligere_\\d*_start$", db2[, unique(variable)]))

tmp <- dbl[, .SD, .SDcols = c("ID", "dep_start", "d_day0", antidep_start_var)]
tmp <- melt(tmp, id.vars = c("ID", "dep_start", "d_day0"))
tmp <- tmp[!is.na(value)]
setorder(tmp)
tmp[, in_interval := fifelse(dep_start <= value & value <= d_day0, 1.0, 0.0)]
tmp <- tmp[, .(n_antidep_start = sum(in_interval)), by=ID]
tmp
dbl <- merge(dbl, tmp, by="ID", all.x=TRUE)
dbl[is.na(n_antidep_start), n_antidep_start := 0]
dbl[, .N, n_antidep_start]

dbl[, f_treatment_resistant := factor(fifelse(n_antidep_start >=2, "Yes", "No"))]
dbl[, f_treatment_resistant := relevel(f_treatment_resistant, "Yes")]
dbl[, .N, keyby=.(f_treatment_resistant, n_antidep_start)]
dbl[, .N, keyby=f_treatment_resistant]
```


```{r}
write_xlsx(dbl, path="02_data_derived/baselinedata.xlsx")
saveRDS(dbl, file="02_data_derived/baselinedata.rds")
```
